overall.headline: Validate LCC/NavBlue and Flag Carrier/Lido outreach; research EAP events first.
observations: Recorded planning: **LCCs, NavBlue 6/10 and Lido 0/10**; **Flag Carriers, Lido 17/29**. Use these as pitch tests, not proven preferences.
Small LCCs reinforce NavBlue (**4/5**) over Lido (**0/5**), but that fleet-specific sample is only five airlines.
For future event research, start with EAP: NavBlue is **9/18 planning-known (50%)**, vs **16/68 overall (24%)**. Check audience fit before booking.
overall.caveat: Selections can include multiple systems per airline; blanks mean unknown.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: Validate FlightKeys planning interest in Europe.
observations: FlightKeys is **4/14 planning-known (29%)**, compared with **12/68 overall (18%)**.
In-house built EFF is **7/35 EFF-known (20%)**, versus **19/127 overall (15%)**. Research events whose audience matches flight-operations buyers.
regions.caveat: Only 35 of 151 airlines have EFF data and 14 have planning data; vendor counts are recorded selections.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: Prioritize EAP for NavBlue-focused discovery and conference scouting.
observations: NavBlue planning is **9/18 (50%)**, compared with **16/68 overall (24%)**; Lido is **7/18 (39%)**.
Use the NavBlue concentration to scout future EAP conferences; verify event audience and agenda before committing.
regions.caveat: Planning coverage is 18 of 130 airlines and EFF coverage is 39 of 130; multi-select values can count one airline in several systems.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: Test FlightKeys and AvioBook in North America; expand event research cautiously.
observations: FlightKeys planning is **5/9 (56%)**, vs **12/68 overall (18%)**; AvioBook EFF is **5/14 (36%)**, vs **21/127 overall (17%)**.
Research North American events with airline planning and EFB audiences before allocating attendance budget.
regions.caveat: Only 14 of 59 airlines have EFF data and 9 have planning data; the conference count does not establish event value.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Validate Lido planning interest before prioritizing conference spend.
observations: Lido planning is **4/9 (44%)**, vs **24/68 overall (35%)**; the sample is only 9 records.
AvioBook, Flightman, and Paper tie at **2/12 EFF records (17%)** each. If researching events, prioritize airline-operations audience fit.
regions.caveat: Only 12 of 56 airlines have EFF data and 9 have planning data. No recorded events may reflect incomplete Airtable coverage.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: No vendor outlier or conference signal is recorded here.
observations: Bytron Skybook, Jeppesen Aviator, and Paper each appear in **3/15 EFF records (20%)**; Lido and NavBlue tie at **3/10 planning records (30%)**.
Vendor rates are close in the recorded sample; gather more market evidence before prioritizing event research.
regions.caveat: Only 15 of 51 airlines have EFF data and 10 have planning data; counts are not adoption shares.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Lido is a discovery lead only; the recorded sample is very small.
observations: Lido is **2/4 planning records (50%)** and IFS EFBOne **2/8 EFF records (25%)**; too few records for a reliable event-targeting signal.
regions.caveat: Only 8 of 47 airlines have EFF data and 4 have planning data; this is insufficient to infer a regional preference.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: Do not infer a South Asia vendor preference from four planning records.
observations: Lido is **2/4 planning records (50%)**; all four EFF records name different systems, so event targeting needs more evidence.
regions.caveat: With four records per system category, vendor comparisons are highly sensitive to individual entries.

regions.name: Unmapped
regions.headline: Resolve location data before making regional targeting decisions.
observations: None of the 11 airlines has an EFF status or planning system recorded; blanks are unknown, not non-adoption.
regions.caveat: Resolve missing or unmatched headquarters and event locations before using this group for regional conclusions.
